# Documentation and evidence revision

The source ZIP is the exact packaged 0.9.7 build source (97 hash-verified files).
The illustrated HTML book, readable delivery documents, HTML acceptance report and
QA evidence were finalized after native testing. They are documentation/evidence
supplements and do not change the installed executable generation or source hash.

Passed proof files are bound to the exact offline package SHA-256 in
qualification.json. Development records retain their historical scope. Heavy
exports, model/runtime duplicates, caches, test installers, private IPC tokens,
raw GPU capture heaps and build checkouts have been removed. Installed runtime and
models are retained for actual offline use. The final source tree is preserved.

41 of 43 universal rows pass. QA-02 and QA-03 remain blocked for the physical
clean-account/offline handoff, and DONE-08 still needs a Mac reboot. This is an
unqualified personal beta; no 1.0 or native UHD/second-Mac support claim is made.
